newsitem.title: USA: Central Illinois shuts 900 MW Coffeen power unit.
newsitem.headline: Central Illinois shuts 900 MW Coffeen power unit.

text.p: Central Illinois Public Service Co's 900 megawatt (MW) Coffeen coal-fired power generation plant was expected to be shut for two to three days for repairs to boiler tube leaks, a company spokesman said.

The 340 MW Coffeen unit 1 was taken off line Tuesday night to repair a boiler tube leak, while the 560 MW unit 2 was shut Wednesday morning, also for a boiler tube leak, spokesman Sam Poe said Wednesday.
"Both those units are expected to be back up running in two to three days," Poe said.
The Coffeen plant is owned and operated by Central Illinois Public Service, and is located about 50 miles southeast of Springfield, Ill.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
